conditions.method: real browser pipeline (Chrome, GPU delegate, pose_landmarker_full.task, MediaPipe tasks-vision 0.10.34)
conditions.filter: verbatim OneEuroFilter port, degree-scale default (minCutoff=1.0, beta=0.1, dCutoff=1.0)
conditions.pose: single subject standing still, arms relaxed at sides, facing camera
conditions.caveats: n=1 subject, 1 session, ~35s, good frontal lighting at ~2-3m. Held-human pose conflates sensor noise with real postural sway. Not a full multi-condition characterization.

headline: At-rest 1-sigma noise in shoulder symmetry is ~1.0 deg (not 3). Robust peak-to-peak ~5.9 deg, worst-case ~9.2 deg. Noise is dominated by low-frequency drift/sway (One Euro barely reduces it at rest). Camera-tilt correction ADDS noise: raw shoulder line is SD 0.80/p2p 3.7, but the tilt-corrected symmetry is SD 1.03/p2p 9.2 because the hip-line reference is the noisiest input.
